name: Not Giving Up
overview: Scripture encourages believers to persevere by trusting in God's presence and strength, as He promises to uphold and help His people in times of fear and discouragement (Isaiah 41:10). God’s plans are for peace and a hopeful future, assuring us that all things work together for good for those who love Him (Jeremiah 29:11; Romans 8:28). Christians are called to remain steadfast in doing good, empowered through Christ who strengthens them, knowing that perseverance will yield a fruitful reward in due time (Galatians 6:9; Philippians 4:13). Transformation through the renewing of the mind enables believers to discern and follow God’s perfect will, further equipping them to not give up amid trials (Romans 12:2).
